prior_year_events.impact_description: Large reduction in gross claims outstanding due to the reinsurance to close transfer of 2019 & prior years to Syndicate 3500.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 312.493m. During 2022 gross claims outstanding reduced materially to GBP 11.200m at year end. The movement was driven primarily by a large reinsurance-to-close transfer of 2019 & prior years to Syndicate 3500 (gross release of GBP 295.729m) together with a small favourable change in estimates of GBP 1.104m (release). Paid claims during the year totalled GBP 4.460m. The net effect was a substantial release of prior year reserves largely due to the RITC together with modest favourable claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: The change in the provisions for claims outstanding during the year was as follows:
Change in estimates of technical provisions, including foreign exchange

The reduction in Financial Investments and Cash and Gross Technical provisions during 2022, primarily reflects the impact of the successful reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account and the continued run-off of Syndicate 2468 through 2022.

Whilst the board of directors of the Managing Agent ("the Board") believes that the provisions for outstanding claims and related reinsurance recoveries including bad debt provisions are fairly stated, these estimates inevitably contain inherent uncertainties

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserve sourced from Balance Sheet (explicit). Prior-year reserve movement: the 'Change in estimates of technical provisions' line was used (-GBP 1.104m) as the prior-year re-estimation (release). A very large additional movement arose from a 2019 & prior reinsurance-to-close transfer out (GBP 295.729m) which dominates the movement but is a transfer rather than pure re-estimation; both items are recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation. Some LOB mappings required judgement (e.g. Credit & suretyship mapped to Reinsurance - Specialty). Gross premiums written for 2022 are effectively nil in the statutory segmental table, so mix percentages are not calculable.
